text.text_excerpt: It's so nice to finally have some great BBQ nearby. I walked in one day after happening across it. I had no idea it was even there. The place makes some mean pulled pork sandwiches. Their sides are great too. I can't wait to go back and try out some more of that BBQ.

The ribs are my favorite main item on the menu here. The pulled pork and wings were a little bland for my liking, but I am from memphis a.k.a. a harsh bar-b-q critic. The banana pudding, as you yelpers before me have noted, is great. My favorite savory side items are the mac and cheese, which is ok or good depending on the day, and the collard greens which are a bit of spicy, salty heaven. You definitely get bang for your buck here if you get the main item and two sides combo-- enough for lunch and leftovers that are enough for dinner later.

Moe's deserves to be in the conversation for best BBQ in town. The food is really good here and everything is reasonably priced. Monday's after 5 all wings are 50 cents and these wings are some of the best wings I've ever had. You can't go wrong with any of the sandwiches or platters. When it comes to sides the Mac is a must and I would then suggest grabbing something off the rotating sides of the day. Some favorites are mash potato casserole, Mississippi mud pie, pork chili, skillet corn, and cornbread. Also, shout out to Bryan and the rest of the crew there. Customer service is top notch.
